about_the_game:
✈️ ABOUT THE GAME

You've been assigned to Terminal 6, a ghost airport sealed since Flight 66 vanished in 1986. As a cargo worker searching for lost luggage, you'll uncover a secret far worse than any crash: this terminal was never meant to reopen.

The rules here bend with every step:

• Your microphone becomes a lifeline, whisper to avoid detection, scream to break the simulation

• Every suitcase holds a fragment of the truth, deliver them correctly or face what's inside

• The terminal watches you back, AI adapts to your playstyle, Steam stats alter your reality

🔍 KEY FEATURES

⌛ TIME-SHIFTING HORROR

Navigate between 1986's disaster, present-day decay, and a glitching simulation where the walls remember your screams.

🎙️ VOICE-DRIVEN NIGHTMARE

• First true microphone horror, your real voice triggers events

• Twitch integration lets viewers influence the AI

• 1986 flight recordings react to your speech patterns

🧠 PSYCHOLOGICAL PUZZLES

• 6-themed challenges, survive 6 minutes in the dark, find 6 hidden passengers

• Light-based navigation, frozen in darkness, hunted in light

• Meta puzzles that use your Steam profile data

📦 BAGGAGE OF THE DAMNED

Each recovered suitcase reveals new rules:

✓ Normal luggage, mundane items with hidden clues

✓ Cursed items, objects that shouldn't exist post-1986

✓ The 6th Case, changes contents based on your playthrough

🌐 REAL-WORLD CONNECTION

Your local time and weather affect the terminal:

• 3:00 AM gameplay unlocks "Nightmare Mode"

• Rain creates flooded corridors with new sounds

⚠️ WARNING

This game:

✓ Uses real ATC recordings from defunct airports

✓ Adapts to your fear responses (via microphone)

✓ Contains 1986-era CRT screen effects

"They closed Terminal 6 for a reason. You're about to learn why."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
